newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 19.

text.p: Toshiba Corp plans to buy a 20 percent stake in being built in Austin, Texas. In return, Toshiba will receive 20 percent of the 64-megabit dynamic random access memory chips (DRAMs) the venture produces. The venture is capitalised at $390 million.

Sumitomo Bakelite Co Ltd is expected to post a record pre-tax profit of 10 billion yen in the year to March 1997, up two percent from a year earlier. This compares with due to a recovery in semiconductor material sales and streamlining efforts.

Sumitomo Heavy Industries Ltd is expected to expand its pre-tax profit by 2.5 times to around 6.5 billion yen in the year to March 1997, helped by the yen"s weakness. Its pre-tax profit is seen rising to around eight billion yen in the year to March 1998 if the dollar stays at the 120 yen level.
